How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

No Makeup Makeup® Foundation is a cream-balm formula, so a little goes a long way. For best results, tap your brush lightly into the compact (don't swirl or dig), then gently buff into the skin, starting at the center of your face and blending outward. Build up coverage only where needed using the same light tapping motion.
